title: The Last Dungeon
source: Newly authored series-premise candidate; not retrieved historic script
summary: The Last Dungeon — Fodder guards a nearly empty cell block while the rest of the fortress closes unprofitable dungeons

panelPlan.action: Fodder guards a nearly empty cell block while the rest of the fortress closes unprofitable dungeons
Eric inspects the only occupied cell, holding a single elderly prisoner
Fodder turns to the prisoner, who is carefully maintaining the ledger of every former captive

dialogueInline.speaker: Fodder
dialogueInline.text: They're shutting every dungeon except ours.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eric
dialogueInline.text: Why keep this one open for one person?

dialogueInline.speaker: Fodder
dialogueInline.text: He's the only one who knows where the keys are.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eric
dialogueInline.text: Why don't you just ask him?
